pages.text: $(o)Blaze-touched and fire-proof.$()$(br2)$(l)Gifts$()$(li)Immune to fire and lava; swim through lava.$(li)Your hits set creatures alight.$(li)+20% Fire spell power.$(li)Phoenix: once every 20 minutes, a killing blow sets everything nearby alight and leaves you at 4 hearts.

$(l)Abilities$()$(li)$(k:key.neoorigins.skill_1): Fireball (20 s): a fire ball that burns creatures where it lands. It breaks no blocks.$(br2)$(l)Drawbacks$()$(li)Water hurts you every second, rain every two.
